claims.claim_text: Provides read-only access to the agentcensus adoption census
claims.reason: Subjective description of the agent's purpose; no oracle can verify 'read-only access' to a proprietary census dataset.

claims.claim_text: Reports current adoption figures with their denominator (Census headline)
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Reports adoption of each discovery mechanism over a window
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Reports errors separately from misses in mechanism adoption statistics
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Reports which discovery labels publishers actually use
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Reports the split between discovery label variants that do not sum
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Looks up what the census has observed for one registrable domain
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data nobody can independently compute.

claims.claim_text: Searches every agent and MCP server the census has discovered, ranked by relevance
claims.reason: Depends on proprietary census data and relevance ranking nobody can independently verify.

claims.claim_text: Returns what each agent publishes to anyone without authentication
claims.reason: Describes behavior conditional on authentication state; no oracle covers this capability claim.

claims.claim_text: Returns what the census observed only to callers with an API key
claims.reason: Describes access-control behavior on proprietary data; no oracle covers this.

claims.claim_text: Exposes an MCP endpoint at https://agentcensus.io/mcp
claims.reason: Checks whether something is serving at the stated URL.

claims.claim_text: Uses JSONRPC protocol binding at protocol version 0.3.0
claims.reason: Claim about protocol format and version, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Supports STREAMABLE-HTTP transport
claims.reason: Claim about transport protocol, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Accepts input in text/plain and application/json formats
claims.reason: Claim about accepted content-type formats, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Returns output in application/json format
claims.reason: Claim about response content-type format, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Supports optional bearer authentication using an API key with ac_live_ prefix or Cognito access token
claims.reason: Claim about authentication scheme and token format, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Meters anonymous callers per IP address
claims.reason: Internal rate-limiting behavior not observable by any external oracle.

claims.claim_text: Meters authenticated callers per organisation
claims.reason: Internal rate-limiting behavior not observable by any external oracle.

claims.claim_text: Does not support push notifications
claims.reason: Claim about absence of a protocol feature, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Does not support streaming
claims.reason: Claim about absence of a protocol feature, checkable by contract/spec inspection.

claims.claim_text: Publishes an agent card at https://agentcensus.io/.well-known/agent-card.json
claims.reason: Checks whether the agent card URL is reachable and returns a successful response.

claims.claim_text: Is registered under the ANS name ans://v2.0.0.agentcensus.io
claims.reason: ANS registration is a proprietary registry claim not verifiable by any catalog oracle.
